scientific_goal: 稳定性、风味/加工与安全条件下的配料表现
minimum_evidence_recommendation: Identity verified; safe intended-use exposure; at least one reproducible relevant assay recommended
invalid_inference: In vitro assay does not establish shelf-life benefit
additional_evidence: Food matrix stability and human exposure if claims are made

scientific_goal: 特定人群和剂量下的健康结局
minimum_evidence_recommendation: Human endpoint evidence for efficacy claim; dose and safety evidence
invalid_inference: ORAC/animal result not a clinical effect
additional_evidence: Controlled human studies with prespecified outcomes

scientific_goal: 解析清除/信号通路与剂量-反应机制
supporting_indicators: D2 source and design;D3 study coverage;D5 reagent stability
minimum_evidence_recommendation: Reproducible identity, orthogonal assays and relevant controls
safety_focus: Assay interference, off-target toxicity, redox cycling
invalid_inference: Mechanistic signal not a product or clinical claim
